description: This file declares the interface for MediaCodecBridge, a class that manages media codec operations on Android, including creating audio/video codecs, handling buffers, and error reporting. It defines enums, structs, and a nested Handler class for callbacks.

classes.name: MediaCodecBridge
classes.description: Class providing an interface to Android's media codec functionalities, including creation, buffer management, and error handling.

classes.name: Handler
classes.description: Callback interface for media codec events such as errors, buffer availability, format changes, and frame rendering.

methods.name: CreateAudioMediaCodecBridge
methods.description: Factory method to create an audio media codec bridge.

methods.name: CreateVideoMediaCodecBridge
methods.description: Factory method to create a video media codec bridge with specified parameters.

methods.name: GetInputBuffer
methods.description: Returns the input buffer object for a given index.

methods.name: QueueInputBuffer
methods.description: Queues an input buffer for decoding.

methods.name: QueueSecureInputBuffer
methods.description: Queues a secure input buffer with DRM info.

methods.name: GetOutputBuffer
methods.description: Returns the output buffer object for a given index.

methods.name: ReleaseOutputBuffer
methods.description: Releases an output buffer, optionally rendering it.

methods.name: ReleaseOutputBufferAtTimestamp
methods.description: Releases an output buffer at a specific timestamp.

methods.name: SetPlaybackRate
methods.description: Sets the playback rate for the media.

methods.name: GetAudioOutputFormat
methods.description: Retrieves the audio output format details.

methods.name: OnMediaCodecInputBufferAvailable
methods.description: Callback when an input buffer becomes available.

methods.name: OnMediaCodecOutputBufferAvailable
methods.description: Callback when an output buffer is available.

methods.name: OnMediaCodecOutputFormatChanged
methods.description: Callback when the output format changes.

methods.name: OnMediaCodecFrameRendered
methods.description: Callback when a frame has been rendered.
